stream_cdc.description: An np2hw stream with its framing flags crossing between two unrelated clocks: np2hw's stream_cdc, on its dual-clock FIFO. A link reset must assert both sides; the pointer paths are constrained by np2hw's own file, scoped to the FIFO.

A.description: The FIFO holds 2**A beats: it absorbs jitter, it is not a rate adapter.

inputs.name: wrst
inputs.description: The write side's reset, active high.

inputs.name: rrst
inputs.description: The read side's reset, active high.
